name: Emmaus
overview: The topic of Emmaus centers on a significant event shortly after Jesus' resurrection, where two disciples traveled to a village approximately sixty furlongs from Jerusalem. Scripture records in Luke 24 that on the first day of the week, early in the morning, the disciples came to the sepulchre with prepared spices, and later that same day, two of them journeyed to Emmaus. This setting frames the remarkable appearance of the risen Christ, emphasizing the reality of His resurrection and the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan, as underscored by the promise of everlasting life through belief in Jesus.
